name: SQL validator safety guard
description: Fires when the SQL safety validator (src/core/chat/sql-validator.ts) is edited, asking the agent to run its unit and property tests and confirm the read-only, forbidden-keyword, and file/network table-function checks were not weakened. Scoped to a single safety-critical file so it only runs on a genuine edit to that file.

then.prompt: src/core/chat/sql-validator.ts was edited. Run its tests: the unit tests in src/core/chat/sql-validator.test.ts and the property tests src/core/chat/sql-validator.forbidden.property.test.ts and src/core/chat/sql-validator.limit.property.test.ts. Then review the diff and confirm that NONE of the safety checks were weakened: the single read-only SELECT/WITH rule, the whole-word forbidden-keyword rejection, the file/network table-function rejection, the table-position and allowlist rules, and the LIMIT enforcement. Report pass or fail and flag any weakening. Do not modify any files.
